name: Postgres hot path plus BigQuery cold analytics
summary: Use Postgres/pgvector for transactional product state and hot search, object storage for raw shards, and BigQuery for cold analytics, vector experiments, ranking, telemetry, and cache-reuse economics.

name: Object storage for raw snapshots and replayable shards
summary: Keep source snapshots, generated media, JSONL partitions, CSV bulk-load files, and archived pages in cheap object storage while Postgres stores canonical metadata and status.

name: BigQuery vector search for cold trajectory fragments
summary: Use BigQuery managed vector indexes for large offline or semi-interactive searches across trajectory fragments, solved subproblems, and embeddings when Postgres hot indexes become too large or analytical scans dominate.
cost_controls: cluster by fragment kind and domain
export serving winners back to Postgres
